dispatch.description: Deterministic feeding, no model: the standby queue and the tick that fills idle lanes. action=add/list/remove/tick/status. A lane is fed only when it is ready AND has no unread mail; the tick reports idle lanes, dispatched this hour, and blocked lanes with reasons.

dunk.description: Scheduled text into a pane (a 'dunk'). action=add/list/get/update/remove/start/stop/stop_all/fire. Superuser-gated (except list/get). {id} in text expands to the dunk's own id at send time.

inbox.description: Agent-to-agent mailbox. action=send (preferred over typing), count, list, read (also returns your tasks), recover, status, ack, cancel, delete, stats, fetch. No size limit; a send nudges the recipient with one line. The owner's mailbox (FLAT_FLEET.md 7.2) is read with action=conversation, answered with action=reply, which keeps the question's transport and links the answer to it, and fed by a bridge with action=ingest (transport + external_id), drained with action=outbox and confirmed with action=delivered (desk and owner only).

memory.description: Deterministic SQLite+FTS5 recall over every agent session. action=recall/context/search/stats/status are read-only and never wait on ingest; ingest/backfill (superuser) queue sources.

metrics.description: Operations measurement. action=summary (counts, duration distributions, coverage), status (daemon health + counts), health (deterministic self-check; repair=true fixes stale leases and a large WAL). action=report generates the deterministic fleet report and posts it to the owner mailbox on the report transport; action=reports lists the files.

pane.description: Inspect and address a pane. action=list/read/delivery/send/send_keys/flush/clear_box/messages/get_message/cancel_message. delivery says whether a lane can receive anything and why not (ready/working/blocked/dead). send_text (send) types plus Enter; when a human is composing it returns queued=true and is delivered later. flush submits a stranded draft; clear_box DESTROYS one (superuser only). Prefer the inbox for agents.

pm.description: Project PMs. action=digest publishes or updates ONE digest per project under a stable id (pm-digest:<project>) with changed/blocked/owner_decisions/numbers so a PM is a digest, not a stream; routing shows the lane->PM registry and whether stray VP mail is redirected or flagged.

superuser.description: The superuser allowlist. action=status/add/remove/recover. Destructive operations are refused unless the caller is on the list.

system.description: Discovery, recovery and the raw escape hatch. action=help (full guide + registry), herdr (rollback-backend passthrough), herdr_help (rollback), recover, doctor.

task.description: Deterministic global task queue. action=next ATOMICALLY claims the highest-priority unblocked task (assigns you + in_progress + a lease); heartbeat extends it; complete/block/unblock finish it; add/list/read/update/assign/cancel/delete manage the queue; follow makes the daemon PUSH work when you are idle; stats/metrics report the board. scope is 'global' (fleet) or 'self' (your pane). All SQL, no model.

views.description: Read-only compositions for the Command Center: roster, message_state, reply_stats, project_summary. All queries, no model, no pane writes.

workspace.description: Layout and the herd. action=list/create/create_tab/split/start_agent/rename/focus/close. Creators and close are superuser-gated; an agent started without a workspace goes to the sandbox, never the caller's tab.
